remaining_risks: Published update metadata and installed-desktop retry behavior remain separate delivery/runtime gates outside this bounded read-only challenge review.

reviewer.isolation_evidence: Read-only review only: no files were edited, no tests were run, and inspection stayed bounded to the snapshot, receipt, updater source, and updater regression tests in the repository.

evidence.result: The bounded updater regression test explicitly verifies that retrying a blocked update clears the failed marker for the running version, performs one fresh update check, and performs one redownload of the newer version.

The detached AppImage installer regression test executes the extracted updater script against whitespace-formatted provenance output and proves the direct replacement is retained only after the expected version is reported as healthy.

The updater contract regression test retains version-comparison assertions, known-good backup and restore coverage, supervised health gating, suppression of previously failed versions, and retry-path contract checks for the bounded rollback protection acceptance.
The repository receipt records the exact four-file npm test command for the updater-focused suite and states that all 39 tests passed, while also scoping out separate delivery/runtime gates.
